name: IMpassion131
published_ref: Miles et al., Lancet Oncol 2021, PMID 34219000 — Atezo+Pac vs Pac in 1L mTNBC
why_failed_or_succeeded: Atezolizumab + standard paclitaxel FAILED to improve PFS in unselected first-line mTNBC. PD-L1+ subgroup also showed NO benefit. This contrasts with IMpassion130 (nab-paclitaxel), which succeeded. The critical difference: standard paclitaxel requires corticosteroid premedication (dexamethasone) which is immunosuppressive, and paclitaxel itself depletes T-cells more than nab-paclitaxel. The taxane delivery vehicle blunted the IO axis.

responder.label: PD-L1+ TNBC (hypothetical responder — trial showed NO benefit even here)

discriminating_axes: io (0.60 vs 0.15) — but trial failed EVEN in PD-L1+ subgroup, suggesting taxane blunts the IO signal regardless
